# ── Cell 1: Config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TERMINAL_CODE   = "CT03"
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
OLD_CONTAINER   = "mundra-ct03"      # container the Data Flow wrote to
NEW_CONTAINER   = "adani-ct03"       # container the new notebook writes to

OLD_SILVER_PATH = f"abfss://{OLD_CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/moves"
NEW_SILVER_PATH = f"abfss://{NEW_CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/moves/"

MERGE_KEY         = "mve_gkey"
SENTINEL_DISTANCE = 100_000_000

OVERLAP_MODE          = "skip"   # "skip": keep new-silver rows as-is | "fill_nulls": fill only NULL target cols from old
MAP_DISTANCES         = True     # dist_carry -> dist_laden, dist_start -> dist_unladen (confirm!)
MAP_UFV_TO_UNIT_VISIT = False    # ufv_gkey -> unit_visit_gkey (only if they are the same gkey)
DRY_RUN               = True     # True = checks only, no write

# Only used if an old timestamp column is still a string (Data Flow formats)
OLD_TS_FORMATS = [
    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",
    "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss", "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm",
    "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss", "dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss",
    "dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss", "dd/MM/yyyy'T'HH:mm:ss",
]

# ── Cell 3: Read old + new, define old -> new mapping ─────────────────────────
assert DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, NEW_SILVER_PATH), \
    "New silver table not found - run MoveHistory_Silver_CT03 first."

old        = spark.read.format("delta").load(OLD_SILVER_PATH)
target     = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, NEW_SILVER_PATH)
tgt_schema = target.toDF().schema
tgt_cols   = [f.name for f in tgt_schema]

_old_lc    = {c.lower(): c for c in old.columns}   # case-insensitive lookup
_old_types = dict(old.dtypes)

# new silver column : (old silver column, kind)
MAPPING = {
    "mve_gkey"              : ("mve_gkey",              "long"),
    "unit_nbr"              : ("Unit_Nbr",              "str"),
    "move_kind"             : ("Move_Kind",             "str"),
    "from_position_name"    : ("From_Position_Name",    "str"),
    "to_position_name"      : ("To_Position_Name",      "str"),
    "t_put"                 : ("t_put",                 "ts"),
    "t_dispatch"            : ("t_dispatch",            "ts"),
    "t_fetch"               : ("t_fetch",               "ts"),
    "t_carry_complete"      : ("t_carry_complete",      "ts"),
    "t_discharge"           : ("t_discharge",           "ts"),
    "t_carry_dispatch"      : ("t_carry_dispatch",      "ts"),
    "t_carry_fetch_ready"   : ("t_carry_fetch_ready",   "ts"),
    "t_carry_put_ready"     : ("t_carry_put_ready",     "ts"),
    "rehandles"             : ("Rehandles",             "int"),
    "category_id"           : ("Category_Id",           "str"),
    "freight_kind_id"       : ("Freight_Kind_Id",       "str"),
    "gross_wt_kg"           : ("Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg",   "dec"),
    "carrier_visit_key"     : ("Carrier_Visit_Key",     "long"),
    "restow_reason"         : ("Restow_Reason",         "str"),
    "pow"                   : ("pow",                   "str"),
    "berth_id"              : ("Berth_Id",              "str"),
    "container_line_id"     : ("Container_Line_Id",     "str"),
    "requires_power_flag"   : ("Requires_Power_Flag",   "bool"),
    "oog_flag"              : ("OOG_Flag",              "bool"),
    "twin_fetch"            : ("Twin_Fetch",            "flag"),
    "twin_carry"            : ("Twin_Carry",            "flag"),
    "twin_put"              : ("Twin_Put",              "flag"),
    "fetch_che_id"          : ("Fetch_CHE_Id",          "id"),
    "fetch_che_kind"        : ("Fetch_CHE_Kind",        "str"),
    "fetch_che_operator_id" : ("Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id", "id"),
    "carry_che_id"          : ("Carry_CHE_Id",          "id"),
    "carry_che_kind"        : ("Carry_CHE_Kind",        "str"),
    "carry_che_operator_id" : ("Carry_CHE_Operator_Id", "id"),
    "put_che_id"            : ("Put_CHE_Id",            "id"),
    "put_che_kind"          : ("Put_CHE_Kind",          "str"),
    "put_che_operator_id"   : ("Put_CHE_Operator_Id",   "id"),
}
if MAP_DISTANCES:
    MAPPING["dist_laden"]   = ("dist_carry", "dec")
    MAPPING["dist_unladen"] = ("dist_start", "dec")
if MAP_UFV_TO_UNIT_VISIT:
    MAPPING["unit_visit_gkey"] = ("ufv_gkey", "long")

_TRUE  = ["YES", "Y", "TRUE", "1", "1.0"]
_FALSE = ["NO",  "N", "FALSE", "0", "0.0"]

def conv(c, kind, dtype):
    s = F.trim(c.cast("string"))
    if kind == "str":
        return F.when(s == "", None).otherwise(s)
    if kind == "id":
        t = F.regexp_replace(s, r"\.0+$", "")
        return F.when(t == "", None).otherwise(t)
    if kind == "long":
        return s.cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("bigint")
    if kind == "int":
        return s.cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("int")
    if kind == "dec":
        return s.cast("decimal(18,3)")
    if kind == "ts":
        if dtype.startswith("timestamp"):
            return c.cast("timestamp")
        return F.coalesce(*[F.to_timestamp(s, f) for f in OLD_TS_FORMATS])
    if kind in ("flag", "bool"):
        u = F.upper(s)
        f = F.when(u.isin(_TRUE), F.lit(1)).when(u.isin(_FALSE), F.lit(0)).otherwise(None)
        return f.cast("byte") if kind == "flag" else f.cast("boolean")
    raise ValueError(kind)

exprs, missing_old = {}, []
for new_name, (old_name, kind) in MAPPING.items():
    real = _old_lc.get(old_name.lower())
    if real is None:
        missing_old.append(old_name)
        continue
    exprs[new_name] = conv(F.col(f"`{real}`"), kind, _old_types[real])

used_old  = {_old_lc[o.lower()] for o, _ in MAPPING.values() if o.lower() in _old_lc}
dropped   = [c for c in old.columns if c not in used_old]
null_only = [c for c in tgt_cols if c not in exprs]   # will be NULL for migrated rows

print(f"Old rows                       : {old.count():,}")
print(f"Mapped columns                 : {len(exprs)}")
print(f"Mapped but missing in old      : {missing_old}")
print(f"Old columns dropped (no target): {dropped}")
print(f"Target columns that stay NULL / derived: {null_only}")

# ── Cell 4: Transform old rows exactly like the new notebook ──────────────────
staged = old.select(*[e.alias(n) for n, e in exprs.items()])

for dist_col in ["dist_unladen", "dist_laden"]:
    if dist_col in staged.columns:
        staged = staged.withColumn(
            dist_col, F.when(F.col(dist_col) >= F.lit(SENTINEL_DISTANCE), None).otherwise(F.col(dist_col)))

staged = (staged
    .withColumn("facility_id", F.lit(TERMINAL_CODE))
    .withColumn("move_date",   F.to_date(F.col("t_put"))))

_type_map = F.create_map(*[x for kv in POSITION_PREFIX_TYPE.items() for x in map(F.lit, kv)])
for side in ("from", "to"):
    pos = F.col(f"{side}_position_name")
    staged = staged.withColumn(
        f"{side}_loc_type",
        F.when(pos.isNull(), None).otherwise(F.coalesce(_type_map[F.substring(pos, 1, 1)], F.lit("OTHER"))))

staged = (staged
    .withColumn("_fm", parse_position_udf(F.col("from_position_name")))
    .withColumn("_to", parse_position_udf(F.col("to_position_name")))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_block",      F.col("_fm.block"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_bay",        F.col("_fm.bay"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_row",        F.col("_fm.row"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_tier",       F.col("_fm.tier").cast("smallint"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_parse_fail", F.col("_fm.parse_fail").cast("boolean"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_block",      F.col("_to.block"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_bay",        F.col("_to.bay"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_row",        F.col("_to.row"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_tier",       F.col("_to.tier").cast("smallint"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_parse_fail", F.col("_to.parse_fail").cast("boolean"))
    .drop("_fm", "_to"))

# One row per key
staged = staged.filter(F.col(MERGE_KEY).isNotNull())
w = Window.partitionBy(MERGE_KEY).orderBy(F.col("t_put").desc_nulls_last(),
                                          F.col("t_carry_complete").desc_nulls_last())
staged = staged.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w)).filter("_rn = 1").drop("_rn")

# Conform to the target schema: same columns, same order, same types; missing -> typed NULL
HASH_EXCLUDE = {"row_hash", "_silver_loaded_at"}
aligned = staged.select(*[
    (F.col(f.name) if f.name in staged.columns else F.lit(None)).cast(f.dataType).alias(f.name)
    for f in tgt_schema if f.name not in HASH_EXCLUDE
])
# Same hash construction as the new notebook (all columns, in table order)
aligned = (aligned
    .withColumn("row_hash", F.xxhash64(*[F.col(c) for c in aligned.columns]))
    .withColumn("_silver_loaded_at", F.current_timestamp())
    .select(*tgt_cols)
    .persist())

print(f"Staged rows (deduped): {aligned.count():,}")
print(f"FROM parse-fail: {aligned.filter('fm_yard_parse_fail').count():,} | "
      f"TO parse-fail: {aligned.filter('to_yard_parse_fail').count():,} | "
      f"Null move_date: {aligned.filter(F.col('move_date').isNull()).count():,}")

# ── Cell 5: Overlap diagnostics ───────────────────────────────────────────────
tgt_df = target.toDF()

print("Old  move_date range:", aligned.agg(F.min("move_date"), F.max("move_date")).collect()[0])
print("New  move_date range:", tgt_df.agg(F.min("move_date"), F.max("move_date")).collect()[0])

ov = (aligned.select(MERGE_KEY, F.col("t_put").alias("t_put_old"))
      .join(tgt_df.select(MERGE_KEY, F.col("t_put").alias("t_put_new")), MERGE_KEY))
n_ov   = ov.count()
n_diff = ov.filter(~F.col("t_put_old").eqNullSafe(F.col("t_put_new"))).count()
print(f"Overlapping {MERGE_KEY}: {n_ov:,}  | rows to insert: {aligned.count() - n_ov:,}")
print(f"Overlap rows where t_put differs: {n_diff:,}  (non-zero => check timezone / format)")
if n_diff:
    display(ov.filter(~F.col("t_put_old").eqNullSafe(F.col("t_put_new")))
              .withColumn("diff_min", (F.unix_timestamp("t_put_new") - F.unix_timestamp("t_put_old")) / 60)
              .limit(20))

# ── Cell 7: Post-check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
result = spark.read.format("delta").load(NEW_SILVER_PATH)
print(f"Rows: {result.count():,}")
print("Duplicate keys:", result.groupBy(MERGE_KEY).count().filter("count > 1").count())
display(result.groupBy(F.year("move_date").alias("yr"), F.month("move_date").alias("mo"))
              .count().orderBy("yr", "mo"))
